title: Northwind engagement survey 2026
brief: Northwind Freight's HR team needs a results page for the 2026 engagement survey, to share with all staff. 842 of 1060 employees responded (79.4 percent). Favorable, neutral and unfavorable percentages for five statements, with last year's favorable percentage in brackets: "I understand how my work supports company goals", 78, 15, 7 (76); "My manager gives me useful feedback", 64, 22, 14 (61); "I have the tools I need to do my job", 71, 18, 11 (70); "I see a path to grow here", 49, 27, 24 (52); "I would recommend this company as a place to work", 69, 20, 11 (66). The average favorable score is 66.2 percent against 65.0 last year, up 1.2 points. The biggest gains are manager feedback and recommendation at 3 points each; the only decline is growth, down 3 points, and it is also the lowest score. Sections: "Response", "Results by statement", "Change since 2025" and "What we will do". What we will do: publish the career framework by 2027-02-28, train 90 managers on giving feedback starting 2026-12-01, and run a short pulse check in April 2027.

edit.request: The growth statement was miscounted: its favorable score is 54, neutral 24, unfavorable 22. Update the average favorable score to 67.2 and the change since last year to 2.2 points.
